plain_english_definition: Unique row identifier present in the corrected collapsed CSV. This field is not described on the official Combined Dataset column page.
codes_or_categories: Unique integer in this file; values are not consecutive.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Treat as a file-level row key, not as student chronology. Use order_id for chronological ordering.
documentation_basis: Observed in downloaded CSV; not officially documented

plain_english_definition: Chronological identifier for the original problem log. Lower values generally correspond to earlier logged interactions.
codes_or_categories: Unique integer in this collapsed file.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Useful for ordering a student’s interactions because the dataset has no absolute response timestamp. Do not assume equal differences in order_id represent equal elapsed time.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the assignment instance. An assignment is specific to a teacher/class, while the same problem set (sequence_id) may be assigned in multiple assignments.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Mostly contextual metadata. Do not use as a numeric magnitude.

plain_english_definition: Anonymized identifier of the student who worked on the problem.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Primary grouping key for longitudinal student modeling. Treat as categorical/identifier, not continuous numeric data.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the ASSISTment. An ASSISTment is an instructional item that can contain a main problem and, when applicable, scaffolding problems.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Multiple problem_id values can belong to the same ASSISTment.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the specific problem presented to the student.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Treat as categorical/identifier. A problem can be encountered by many students.

plain_english_definition: Indicates whether the row is the main/original problem or a scaffolding problem.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: For a clean next-problem correctness model, it is often reasonable to begin with original = 1 and analyze scaffolding separately.

plain_english_definition: Whether the student was correct on the first attempt. In Skill Builder assignments, requesting tutoring (a hint or “Break this Problem Into Steps”) causes the problem to be marked incorrect.
codes_or_categories: 1 = correct on first attempt; 0 = incorrect on first attempt or requested help.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Common prediction target. Because help-seeking can force correct=0, it represents independent first-attempt success rather than final eventual correctness.

plain_english_definition: Number of answer attempts the student made on this problem.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The downloaded file contains some 0 values and a very large maximum, so inspect/outlier-handle before modeling.

plain_english_definition: Time from problem start until the student’s first action, measured in milliseconds. The first action may be an answer attempt or a request for help.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The actual CSV contains negative and extremely large values, indicating data-quality issues. Do not use raw without validation, clipping/winsorization, or exclusion rules.

plain_english_definition: Mode in which the problem was delivered.
codes_or_categories: Observed in this file: tutor, test. Older documentation also mentions pre-test/post-test modes, but they are not present here.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Use observed categories from this CSV rather than assuming all categories listed in older documentation exist.

plain_english_definition: Format used for the student response.
codes_or_categories: Observed: algebra = math-evaluated text response; choose_1 = single-choice multiple choice; fill_in_1 = fill-in text/string response; choose_n = select-multiple response; open_response = open response.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The official older page says fill_in, but the actual corrected collapsed file uses fill_in_1. choose_n is also present although not listed on that page.
documentation_basis: Official documentation reconciled to observed file

plain_english_definition: Identifier for the problem set (historically called a sequence). Different assignments can reference the same sequence_id.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Content-level identifier; treat as categorical.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the class associated with the student/assignment.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Contextual identifier. Treat as categorical and avoid interpreting its numeric magnitude.

plain_english_definition: Position of the assignment on the class assignments page.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: This is assignment-page position, not the student’s within-problem response order.

plain_english_definition: Problem-set type field. It corresponds to the concept called problem_set_type on the Combined Dataset documentation page.
codes_or_categories: Observed in this Skill Builder file: MasterySection only.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Because every row has the same value in this downloaded file, it has no predictive variance and can normally be dropped from modeling.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the original problem set when a sequence has been copied; otherwise it may equal sequence_id.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Useful for grouping copied versions of the same underlying problem set.

plain_english_definition: Identifier(s) for the math skill(s)/knowledge component(s) associated with the problem. In this corrected collapsed file, multiple skill IDs for one student-problem are combined into one underscore-delimited string.
codes_or_categories: Examples: 311; 47; 1_13; 2_37_70. Literal NA is also present and should usually be interpreted as missing skill information.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Read as string, not numeric. Split on underscore only if you intentionally want individual skills; otherwise a composite can be treated as a joint skill tag.
documentation_basis: Skill Builder corrected-file description + observed file

plain_english_definition: Human-readable name of the skill associated with the problem.
codes_or_categories: Examples include Equation Solving Two or Fewer Steps, Proportion, Box and Whisker. Blank values occur.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The collapsed file may contain composite skill_id values even when skill_name shows one readable label; use skill_id as the more reliable machine key.

plain_english_definition: Anonymized identifier of the teacher who assigned the problem.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Contextual identifier; not needed for a student-skill proficiency project unless explicitly modeling teacher/class effects.

plain_english_definition: Anonymized identifier of the school where the problem was assigned.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Contextual identifier; treat as categorical, not continuous.

plain_english_definition: Number of hints the student requested while working on the problem.
codes_or_categories: Count from 0 upward; observed range in this file is 0–10.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The older 2009–10 page contains a wording error that describes this as attempts; the more detailed ASSISTments interpretation page clearly defines it as hints requested.

plain_english_definition: Total number of hints available for the problem.
codes_or_categories: Count; observed range in this file is 0–10.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Can be used with hint_count to derive a fraction of available hints used. A value of 0 means no hints were available/defined.

plain_english_definition: Intended estimate of total time the student spent completing the problem, in milliseconds, including time across attempts/hints.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: ASSISTments explicitly warns this field is often computed incorrectly. The uploaded file also contains negative and extreme values; treat it as noisy and validate before use.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the ASSISTment template. ASSISTments sharing a template_id have similar/templated questions.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Potential way to group structurally similar questions. Treat as categorical.

plain_english_definition: Identifier of the answer option selected for multiple-choice/select-type questions.
codes_or_categories: Integer-like answer IDs when applicable; literal NA for most rows where no answer-option ID applies.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Read as string because NA is used as a literal missing marker. Mainly relevant for multiple-choice analyses.

plain_english_definition: Student-entered answer text, or selected value, when recorded for the response type.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Read as text even when values look numeric. Avoid numeric type inference. User-entered response text can be noisy and should be handled cautiously.

plain_english_definition: Type of the student’s first action after opening the problem.
codes_or_categories: 0 = answer attempt; 1 = hint request; 2 = scaffolding / break problem into steps.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: The Combined page only loosely describes attempt vs hint; the detailed interpretation page documents the scaffolding code 2, which is present in this file.

plain_english_definition: Indicates whether the student requested the final “bottom-out” hint, which generally reveals the answer.
codes_or_categories: 1 = requested bottom-out hint; 0 = used hinting but did not request bottom-out hint; literal NA = no hint was requested / not applicable.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Read as categorical/string rather than numeric because this CSV uses the literal NA marker. Scaffolding questions cannot receive hints.

plain_english_definition: Count of opportunities the student has had to practice the associated skill up to and including this interaction, as supplied by the dataset.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Highly relevant to knowledge/proficiency modeling. In this collapsed file a student-problem has one row even when skill_id is composite, so interpret the supplied count as the dataset’s collapsed opportunity value rather than reconstructing per-skill counts from this field alone.

plain_english_definition: Number of opportunities the student has had to practice the skill when counting only original/main problems.
codes_or_categories: Positive integer when present; blank values occur, especially for scaffolding rows.
data_quality_and_modeling_notes: Useful when modeling independent main-problem practice. Preserve as nullable integer.
